g.text: kills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/skills.md): Load and use skills to give your agents the context they need to use MCP tool
s effectively\n- [Playground](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/playground.md): Chat with your MCP servers, invoke tools by hand,
render widgets, and inspect every step — all in one IDE-style workspace\n- [Evaluate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md):
Author test cases for your MCP server, run them across models, and gate pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-a
s-judge.\n- [Compatibility](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/compatibility.md): Check whether your MCP server works on each AI ho
st — conformance gates, per-host findings, and live widget rendering.\n- [View origins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/view-ori
gins.md): Which origin your MCP App's view runs at, and how to allowlist it with a third-party API\n- [Contribute a Host](https://
docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/host-templates.md): Add a new host preset to MCPJam so widgets can render under that host's identity, ca
pabilities, and sandbox policy.\n- [OAuth Debugger](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/guided-oauth.md): Debug your MCP server's OA
uth implementation at every step of the handshake\n- [XAA Debugger](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/xaa-debugger.md): Configure
and debug Cross-App Access flows with MCPJam as the test identity provider and client/agent\n- [Mid-session sign-in](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/inspector/lazy-authentication.md): Test servers that let you connect without signing in and ask for sign-in only when a
protected call needs it\n- [MCP Inspector](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/tools-prompts-resources.md): Manually test your MCP
server's tools, resources, and prompts\n- [Events and Triggers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/events.md): Inspect a server's M
CP Events, subscribe to them, and run an agent when they arrive\n- [Tracing & debugging](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/debu",
